stories.title: Unified framework shows thermoelectric performance depends on more than the material itself
stories.desc: Thermoelectric materials can directly convert heat into electricity, making them promising for recovering waste heat from factories, vehicles and other sources. stories.title: Scientists are building a microscope powered by a quantum computer
stories.desc: Scientists are combining an electron microscope with a quantum computer to squeeze far more information from each electron. The approach could reveal faint details with fewer electrons, helping protect fragile samples that conventional microscopy can damage.
